278710494.description: This lot features eight sealed VHS-C camcorder tapes from Maxell, TDK, and JVC. Included are Maxell TC-30 Premium High Grade HGX-Gold tapes in gold packaging, TDK TC-30 HG Ultimate tapes with blue and gold packaging, and JVC TC-30 PROHF and TC-30 EHG tapes labeled High Energy in gold/black and blue/black boxes. These tapes are compatible with VHS-C camcorders and come in a variety of packaging colors.

278518453.description: This collection includes a variety of rocks, minerals, and tumbled gemstones weighing 2.60lbs. The assortment features polished stones, raw mineral specimens, and fossil pieces in colors such as brown, red, yellow, white, gray, black, green, purple, and blue. Included are possible quartz, agate, jasper, amethyst, petrified wood, and a fossilized spiral shell. The stones are in mixed condition, with some tumbled and polished while others remain in rough, natural form.
